scope: fixed N->infinity fast model-time horizons T, fixed alpha in (0,1)
global_drift_error: O_P(|m| sqrt(N)||w|| + sqrt(N)||w||^2 + N^-1/2) integrated on bounded T ->0
private_drift_error: uniform O_alpha(N^-1/2) per unit model time
bracket_error: integral probability from E|p-u|->0 and E|p_B-p|->0 under stationary reflected lift
parent_transfer: MT initial outside-domain + reflected mixing + actual exit, all retained
